title: Current RxSock6 qualification evidence
summary: Fresh ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 qualification against Socket Provider dev16 passed RxSock6 TCP6 and UDP6 routes. The UDP6 path performed live ::1 datagram request/reply while preserving the peer .Inet6Address object. IPv6 multicast evidence belongs to IP Multicast dev2.
invariants: TCP6 and UDP6 live evidence are distinct from multicast evidence.
UDP6 qualification must preserve the received peer .Inet6Address object rather than flattening it.
Do not infer an RxSock6 multicast capability from the existence of SOCK_DGRAM.
Do not infer an MLDv2 implementation from observed host membership state.
procedure: After exact dev3 source is synchronized to GitHub, rerun the TCP6 and UDP6 live suite against Socket Provider dev16 and ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 before declaring the repository source requalified.

provenance.claim: Records the reconciled RxSock6 provider dev3 and IP Multicast dev2 heads and their current evidence.
Records the RxSock6 dev3 UDP6 live qualification and the separate IPv6 multicast/MLDv2 evidence boundary.
